item.title: Why UI SDK? I spent 99% of my time only polishing the feel: the look, sound, haptics, words.
item.author: @shuding
item.description:
Why UI SDK?

I spent 99% of my time only polishing the feel: the look, sound, haptics, words. Agents handled the code.

The components worked perfectly, plus great accessibility, aria labels, announcements, and full keyboard control. These all came for free with UI SDK.

https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/core/behaviors/lists#find-in-page…

item.title: UI behaviors → we’re here + Stateful coordination → element logic + React/Vue/Svelte/… → components + Tailwind/StyleX/… →
item.author: @shuding
item.description:
UI behaviors → we’re here
+ Stateful coordination → element logic
+ React/Vue/Svelte/… → components
+ Tailwind/StyleX/… → design systems

Lower level, accessible, atomic units. Faster to build systems on top with focus on your design.

The periodic table of UIs.

item.title: UI and math time! UI = f(props) is the most famous line in React. But that f is
item.author: @shuding
item.description:
UI and math time! UI = f(props) is the most famous line in React. But that f is JavaScript, not math.

Inspired by @_chenglou’s Handwired project, I compiled a <Dashboard/> component into a real math function, and asked what becomes possible.

https://calculus-of-interfaces.vercel.app
